purpose: Store explicit scenario trees for catalyst/speculative theses. Probabilities are research estimates, not facts, and must be revised when evidence changes.

scenarios.name: Wrath rune selected
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Recalculate from live tape and current pre-positioning; do not reuse stale historical targets.
scenarios.evidence: Wrath is thematically plausible and has limited existing sinks, but Jagex has not confirmed the rune.
scenarios.invalidation: Official statement or implementation selects a different rune or removes the rune requirement.

scenarios.name: Another existing rune selected
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Wrath likely loses catalyst premium; selected rune reprices depending on supply and consumption rate.
scenarios.evidence: The proposal only states a rune of some kind; several rune markets are plausible candidates.

scenarios.name: Charge design materially changes / new resource dominates
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Existing rune speculation loses value; exact impact depends on redesign.
scenarios.evidence: Reward design can change before implementation.
scenarios.invalidation: Final implementation preserves a meaningful existing-rune sink.

review_triggers: JMod statement naming or narrowing the rune
sector-specific rune accumulation unexplained by broader rune movement

models.theme: Legacy elemental hardware benefits from Raid 4 / elemental systems

scenarios.name: Legacy elemental gear gains major Raid 4 utility
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Recalculate item-by-item; lower-priced hardware may have greater percentage convexity than already-expensive gear.
scenarios.evidence: Elemental reward design and weakness mechanics can increase relevance of existing elemental spellcasting infrastructure.
scenarios.invalidation: Raid mechanics heavily favor new rewards or non-elemental meta with little legacy interaction.

scenarios.name: Mixed utility / only selected legacy pieces benefit
beneficiaries: Subset determined by exact spell, off-hand and special-attack mechanics
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Sector dispersion; relative-value analysis is more important than broad basket exposure.
scenarios.evidence: Different staffs/tomes interact differently with off-hands, spell damage, specials and weakness systems.
scenarios.invalidation: Broad explicit compatibility or incompatibility is confirmed.

scenarios.name: New Raid 4 rewards displace legacy elemental hardware
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Legacy speculative premium can unwind sharply.
scenarios.evidence: New endgame rewards can cannibalize older niches.
scenarios.invalidation: Official mechanics clearly preserve or enhance legacy gear roles.

models.theme: Inquisitor benefits from increased Crush relevance

scenarios.name: Raid 4 materially increases demand for Inquisitor armour
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Recalculate from live tape and supply conditions.
scenarios.evidence: Crush-focused reward/encounter direction can increase value of Crush accuracy/damage setups.
scenarios.invalidation: Encounter design or gear progression bypasses Inquisitor.

scenarios.name: Crush becomes important but Breaker/new off-hands reduce legacy weapon demand
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Armour may outperform Inquisitor mace; analyze pieces separately.
scenarios.evidence: Breaker can increase Crush relevance while simultaneously displacing some legacy weapons.
scenarios.invalidation: Final mechanics make Inquisitor set bonus/mace uniquely valuable together.

scenarios.name: Crush relevance does not translate into Inquisitor demand
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Inquisitor catalyst premium fades and supply dominates.
scenarios.evidence: Boss stats, accuracy requirements, new gear or set incompatibility can break the assumed link.
scenarios.invalidation: Strong live usage evidence or explicit encounter design supports Inquisitor.

models.theme: Arcane/Dex recover after CoX supply reduction

scenarios.name: Supply reduction eventually dominates and scrolls recover
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Recovery magnitude depends on inventories and marginal demand; recalculate from live trend.
scenarios.evidence: Implemented drop-weight changes reduce new scroll supply.
scenarios.invalidation: Persistent selling and weak demand absorb the structural supply change for an extended period.

scenarios.name: Prices stabilize but remain range-bound
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Low opportunity-adjusted return; cash or other trades may dominate.
scenarios.evidence: Stockpiles and existing ownership can delay repricing.

scenarios.name: Demand weakness / inventory overhang causes further downside
scenarios.expected_return_if_triggered: Further drawdown despite improved supply fundamentals.
scenarios.evidence: Current tape may remain distribution-heavy after the update.

rules.pricing: All scenario return estimates must be recalculated from fresh RuneLite/Wiki market data at decision time.
rules.uncertainty_penalty: Lower GP Deployment Score when scenario outcome prices or probabilities are weakly supported.
